text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold positions at a gain, but should not let the satisfaction of locking in profits replace considering each stock’s future prospects and the portfolio as a whole.","Buying Stock B after selling it at a gain shows how easily I can chase a higher price; I should set clear reasons and limits before buying again.","A portfolio can lose value even after several winning trades, so I should manage overall risk and diversification rather than judge each holding only against its purchase price."]}
